description.narrative: TI BiH har lämnat in en ansökan, tillsammans med budget och mål, avseende kärnstöd till kärnverksamhet, till Sida. Sida har beslutat att bevilja stöd som exklusivt får användas för implementering av TI:s kärnaktiviteter baserat på de väsentliga strategiska prioriteringarna fastlagda i TI:s strategiska plan för 2015–2020. Dessa prioriteringar är: Etablera ett starkt och produktivt samarbete med medborgare och institutioner, med ytterligare fokus på identifiering av förändringsmedel inom institutionerna; Anta och övervaka införandet och verkställigheten av anti-korruptionsstandarder och policys på alla politiska nivåer i landet, och kampen mot social rättvisa; Förstärka kapaciteten och bilden av TI BiH och förbättra organisationens position på global nivå; Eftersträvansvärda resultat i slutet av projektet är: • Ökad beslutsamhet hos individer och partners att vidta åtgärder mot korruption och delta i beslutsprocessen • Etablerade och förstärkta koalitioner och partnerskap med relevanta intressenter • Förbättrad och förstärkt lagstiftning mot korruption baserad på relevanta internationella standarder och rekommendationer • Effektivare tillämpning av lagar och normer och minskad straffrihet för korrupta handlingar • Förbättrat genomförande av strategier och planer mot korruption hos ledande institutioner • Högre nivå av integritet hos organisationer och individer • Förbättrad mottaglighet, närvaro, påverkan av, och prestationsförmåga hos, TI BiH på alla nivåer

TI BiH has submitted an application, including budget and objectives to Sida for core financial support to its core activities. Sida has decided to award a grant to be used exclusively for the implementation of the TI's core activities based on the main strategic priorities defined by its Strategic plan 2015–2020 which are: Establishing a strong and productive cooperation with citizens and institutions, with additional focus on agents of change identified within institutions; The adoption and monitoring the introduction and enforcement of anticorruption standards and policies at all levels of government in the country, and the fight for social justice; Enhancing the capacities and image of Transparency International BiH and improving the organisation’s position in the global network Desired outcomes identified by the end of the intervention are: • Increased empowerment of people and partners to take action against corruption and participate in decision-making process • Established and strengthened coalitions and partnerships with all relevant stakeholders • Improved and strengthened anti-corruption legislation based on relevant international standards and recommendations • More effective enforcement of laws and standards and reduced impunity for corrupt acts • Improved implementation of anti-corruption strategies and plans in leading institutions • Higher levels of integrity demonstrated by organisations and people • Enhanced responsiveness, presence, performance and impact of TI BiH at all levels

TI BiH has submitted an application, including budget and objectives to Sida for core financial support to its core activities. Sida has decided to award a grant to be used exclusively for the implementation of the TI's core activities based on the main strategic priorities defined by its Strategic plan 2015-2020 which are: 1. Establishing a strong and productive cooperation with citizens and institutions, with additional focus on agents of change identified within institutions; 2. The adoption and monitoring the introduction and enforcement of anti-corruption standards and policies at all levels of government in the country, and the fight for social justice; 3. Enhancing the capacities and image of Transparency International BiH and improving the organisations position in the global network.
Desired outcomes identified by the end of the intervention are: 1. Increased empowerment of people and partners to take action against corruption and participate in decision making process, 2. Established and strengthened coalitions and partnerships with all relevant stakeholders, 3. Improved and strengthened anti-corruption legislation based on relevant international standards and recommendations, 4. More effective enforcement of laws and standards and reduced impunity for corrupt acts, 5. Improved implementation of anti-corruption strategies and plans in leading institutions, 6. Higher levels of integrity demonstrated by organisations and people, 7. Enhanced responsiveness, presence, performance and impact of TI BiH at all levels.

Advocacy During the four-year period of core support, TI BiH participated in, drafted proposals, recommendations, prepared comments and acted towards relevant institutions and parliaments in the case of more than 70 drafts and law proposals, including rule books and strategic documents relevant for prevention of corruption, good governance, integrity, transparency, as well as protection of basic rights. Through around 50 events organized for the purpose of informing the stakeholders on advocacy initiatives and recommendations, and exchanging views and providing support for their adoption, TI BiH engaged around 2000 participants from governments, regulatory bodies, civil society, media and academia.
Legal assistance to citizens From 2019 to 2023, more than 6300 citizens contacted TI BiH through its free line for reporting corruption and received legal assistance through its Advocacy and Legal Advice Center. Following up on their initial contact, they either reported specific cases of corruption or received advice on how to proceed with their legal issues. Based on citizen reports from this period, TI BiH initiated and acted on 1.086 cases of corruption or other law violations, including violations of human rights. TI BiH filed around 20 reports to prosecutors offices on different levels, related to abuse of office and corruption. Besides that, TI BiH filed more than 40 reports related to conflicts of interest among public officials, including some high profile cases. Based on TI BiH reports, several conflict of interest cases were determined by competent authorities and, as a result, fined or removed from their offices. Through acting on individual cases, undertaking monitoring of different sectors, and providing support to the media and other CSOs, within the fouryear period, TI BiH filed almost 100 lawsuits against public institutions and SOEs, while TI BiH won in 78 cases.
Monitoring and analyses Based on monitoring approximately 15,000 public procurement procedures, more than 250 cases related to irregularities in public procurement were referred to relevant institutions, and a significant number of tenders ceased based on TI BiH reports. Almost 5000 examples of the use of state resources for election purposes were identified through two election cycles and the monitoring of around 2000 public events and rallies. Around 200 reports were filed with the Central Election Commission, and around 50 sanctions were imposed on political parties based on TI BiH reports. Additional 20 sanctions were imposed based on TI BiH monitoring of the financial reports of political parties. 528 state owned enterprises are monitored annually through the TI BiH SOE database, including analyses on their financial indicators, governance, public procurement, etc. More than 4000 public officials and 7000 members of supervisory boards of SOEs and institutions were monitored through the public officials registry, and more than 250 cases were identified where officials held multiple functions, resulting in more than 40 reports for law violations. Almost 15000 grants to associations in the amount of more than 120 million KM were monitored through the grant database. TI BiH is the most reliable source on the trends in the prosecution of corruption, with its unique data map presenting information on reports, investigations, indictments, and verdicts across all levels. Additionally, TI BiH has, in the past period, directly monitored around 60 trials for corruption, and around 30 disciplinary cases against judges and prosecutors. TI BiH initiated the only database on court rulings related to access to information, containing more than 200 court decisions across all levels.
Empowerment, outreach and capacity building During the past 4 years, as a result of its public engagement, TI BiH had around 18.000 mentions in the media, while the online databases had around 350.000 visits, where users are most often journalists, researchers, civil society, and also the general population. The TI BiH mobile application Reflektor for reporting election irregularities had, in 3 months only, around 15,000 downloads and received more than 600 reports from citizens. The first season of the podcast Pretres, which TI BiH implemented together with the portal Capital.ba, had around 660,000 views. The most prominent is the TI BiH School of Integrity, which gathers young leaders from political parties, CSOs, and media and, through a carefully designed three module program, engages them to create public policies on issues related to integrity, democratic society, the rule of law, and human rights. In this four year period, TI BiH educated seven generations of School of Integrity, with around 170 participants, and also created alumni sessions in order to maintain the network of young leaders. During more than 20 different workshops and trainings, TI BiH engaged around 1200 training participants from the mentioned sectors.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
